patch_description:
Replace the order-sensitive single greedy expansion with a deterministic multi-start shared-tree search. The current algorithm always attaches the destination with the cheapest immediate extension first; that can consume a cheap branch point and prevent a slightly more expensive initial trunk from unlocking substantially lower-cost fan-out to the remaining clouds.

The replacement evaluates the normal greedy construction plus one construction seeded by each reachable destination. Each construction still charges an edge only once, so it preserves broadcast sharing and overlapping transfer opportunities. Selecting the least-cost installed-edge set reduces redundant inter-cloud transfers while retaining a source-rooted directed topology that can be materialized for every partition.
